assets.name: 灵火爆炸
assets.scene: Visual event: a downward sword thrust DETONATES COLD GHOSTFLAME at its tip. Translate Image 1's deeply hunched forward figure and ground-level explosion into Wylder: he bends low at center-left, knees braced, helmet turned down toward sword point; right sword hand presses the greatsword down into the ground near lower center, free arm raised behind for balance. One slightly diagonal STRAIGHT sword runs from forked pommel above the grasp, through the same grip and crossguard, to the exploding point below. The impact erupts in a wide jagged WHITE/ICE-CYAN burst across the lower half with 3-4 bold clawlike ghostflame tongues curving upward behind him. A few large abstract deathly flame shapes, NOT actual summoned birds, skull monsters or extra characters. Keep helmet and sword hand cleanly readable above the burst. Palette: silver and navy Wylder, near-black cold teal background, cyan-white ghostfire with dark midnight BLUE cores; absolutely NO orange fire. Graphic hard flat flame shapes, not mist, water, lightning or photoreal translucent smoke. Composition feels like a COLD EXPLOSION, not a vertical projectile or spinning slash.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: opaque full-bleed 1000x760 LANDSCAPE game card ARTWORK ONLY; one illustration, not a collage.
STYLE: follow the original Slay the Spire 2 card-art reference images: graphic flat 2D illustration, big chunky angular silhouettes, broad flat color blocks, only 2-4 HARD-EDGED cel-shaded planes per material, large deliberate BLACK shadow shapes, single saturated rim/accent color, intentionally exaggerated perspective. No realistic texture or reflections, no tiny engraving, no dense individually-rendered scales. One unmistakable visual event filling 70-90% of frame, legible at 250x190, abstract minimal background.
Avoid text, letters, numbers, card frame, cards/card backs/card-shaped rectangles, UI, logos, watermark, photorealism, painterly brushwork, cinematic fog, detailed background scenery, noisy sparks. Steel weapons must have one STRAIGHT continuous centerline from pommel base, grip, crossguard to tip. Curving flame/motion effects are NOT steel. No bent blade, no duplicate handle, no two swords.
Input roles: Image 1 is the USER'S pose/effect reference, NOT its other character, mannequin, weapon curvature or realistic rendering; Image 2 is ONLY Wylder's identity/equipment, NOT its idle pose or detailed combat-sprite rendering; Images 3 and 4 are original-game graphic card-art STYLE references only.
Wylder identity: fully CLOSED silver helmet, silver front faceguard, dark eye slit; the blue panel is on SIDE/BACK of helmet, never a blue cloth face mask. Small segmented metal feather wings. Black layered scarf, V-bottom silver breastplate and asymmetrical shoulders, navy short sleeves with grouped angular silver scales, brown gloves, dark NAVY split knee-length skirt with sparse white flowing embroidery, dark trousers and rope-wrapped boots. Simplify to big flat shapes; do not copy dense decorative etching.
ONE very long broad STRAIGHT silver greatsword, navy grip, compact silver crossguard, distinctive silver FORKED SCULPTURAL POMMEL (outward hooked branches, not a generic round ball or disk). Pommel central base, single grip, guard center, full blade centerline and tip lie on ONE uninterrupted straight axis; only fork decorations may curl outwards. If both hands grip it, they hold the SAME continuous handle. A small round navy buckler can be discreetly secured to the back where visible; not a second weapon. No exposed face, glowing orange eye, bird head, antlers, enormous cape or extra limbs.

assets.name: 唤起灵火
assets.scene:
Input roles: Image 1 is the PRIMARY WEAPON AND EFFECT reference; Images 2 and 3 are original-game STYLE references. NO character identity image is provided because this is an OBJECT-ONLY card.
Visual event: cold ghostflame awakens ALONG a black gothic greatsword, coating its blade.
Preserve Image 1's recognizable Helphen's Steeple silhouette: a long perfectly STRAIGHT black blade with stepped, hooked cathedral-spire buttresses along its sides, compact gothic crossguard and one dark continuous grip. Restyle this special card weapon rather than replacing it with a generic broad sword. Main centerline from tip at upper-left to pommel at lower-right is one perfectly straight diagonal; only side buttress ornaments curve outward. Do not reproduce tiny etching or realistic metal texture.
Composition: oversized isolated blade runs upper-left to lower-right across almost the entire landscape canvas, point and grip both readable. Surround its sides with 3 large WHITE/PALE CYAN cold flame tongues that hug the blade rather than a huge explosion; cobalt-blue hard shadow cores. One dark flat navy/purple background with 2-3 arching shadow shapes. Sword uses 2-3 near-black/blue-gray planes with sharp cyan rim, not realistic shine. NO hands, no knight, no altar, no levitating duplicates, no floating cards. This is an activated sustained weapon enchantment, not the other card's detonating ghostflame.

assets.name: 尸蜡斩击
assets.scene:
Visual event: a downward sword release launches a TALL RED-BLACK corpse-wax blade-wave.
Match Image 1: Wylder is low at lower-left in three-quarter back view, torso hunched forward with a bent front knee, finishing a powerful downward swing. He holds his one STRAIGHT greatsword low to right, rigid grip and blade sharing one line; most of the weapon can be partially occluded by the effect but do not draw a bent exposed shaft. A huge thin upright RED crescent-wave fills the right two-thirds, white-hot edge, crimson layered slashes and near-black core, detached from the physical sword. The wave is not ordinary orange flame, blood spray or a cyan storm: make it a sharp deathly red/black shearing cut, with 2-3 long dark-red trailing strands suggesting lingering life-sapping wax. Silver/navy armored silhouette on deep purple-black backdrop, pale red rim. Single release moment; no enemy, no gore, no realistic smoke. The blade-wave has a clear clean graphic edge and dark negative-space cutouts. Preserve the directional crouch-and-release composition of the reference.

assets.name: 亵渎火焰
assets.scene:
Visual event: kneeling Wylder RAISES HIS GREAT SWORD STRAIGHT OVERHEAD as blasphemous flame awakens.
Follow Image 1's pose/composition: armored figure low at lower-center, deep braced kneeling stance, BOTH hands grasping ONE continuous long handle just above the helmet; very long RIGID STRAIGHT blade rises almost vertically up the center to the top edge. Distinct forked silver pommel is below both hands along the same straight sword axis, not another guard or extra handle. Character looks upward along the sword, CLOSED helmet visible from front/three-quarter; do not replace it with the reference's original knight or tiny skulls.
A broad ORANGE/SCARLET fire canopy surges outward across the upper half from the raised blade, strong cream edge and large black negative-space tongues, framed against deep burgundy/navy. Main steel blade remains a visible narrow silver straight spine inside the flames. Add only 2 thin red ember-stream ribbons curving back toward the chest to hint stolen vitality, no UI heart or health symbols. It is an overhead ignition/charged release moment, not a horizontal fire fan from a hand and not a crouched red projectile. Hard-edged cartoon flames, no realistic fire texture. Tight monumental composition, crop boots if necessary.
